addon.name: Ashutosh Invasion
addon.author: Ashutosh
addon.description: True Hi-Res Lossless FLAC by default via tracks.monochrome.st, with Piped fallback only on FLAC failure for BitChord.

fallback.note: Piped is NEVER tried first. Use only if the primary FLAC path fails.
triggerOn: primary search returns zero tracks / empty topResults
primary stream does not start with 'fLaC' magic bytes
primary stream Content-Length < 100000 bytes (likely error JSON, not audio)
rules: Always attempt primary monochrome search + /track/{monoId} first.
Only on one of the triggerOn failures, re-query fallback search and resolve via Piped {id}.
Never mix IDs: monochrome numeric IDs go only to primary resolver, Piped YouTube IDs go only to fallback resolver.
If fallback also fails, surface the primary error, not the fallback error.

idResolution.note: Piped.video YouTube IDs (11-char) are NOT compatible with tracks.monochrome.st numeric track IDs (18-digit). Do not pass a Piped {id} directly to streamResolver.
steps: 1. Query endpoints.search with '{artist} {title}' (or ISRC if known). Response shape: { tracks: [{ id, trackId, title, artistNames[], releaseId, artwork, duration (ms), isrc, playable }], topResults, releases, artists }.
2. Pick best match: prefer topResults[0] with entityType=track, else tracks[0]. Optionally score by title match + artistNames overlap + duration within 5s + ISRC equality.

3. Use the chosen tracks[].id (== trackId) as {id} in endpoints.streamResolver. Example: /track/155142639597916160 returns raw FLAC (content-type: application/octet-stream, magic 'fLaC', ~35MB, Accept-Ranges: bytes, Cache-Control immutable).
4. Fallback for cached Piped IDs: keep Piped title/artist metadata, run step 1-3 to re-resolve to a monochrome ID instead of calling streamResolver with the stale YouTube ID.

streamRules.note: DEFAULT: Direct lossless FLAC binary, no transmux. Supports HTTP Range (206) for seeking.
FALLBACK ONLY: lossy Opus via Piped. Never selected unless primary FLAC errors.

streamRules.condition: primary FLAC fails AND priority-2 Opus unavailable
streamRules.note: FALLBACK ONLY: lossy AAC via Piped. Last resort.
